<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SN2 substitution where a halide (e.g., Cl) is displaced by an amine, forming a C‑N bond and breaking a C‑Cl bond. The forward reaction breaks a halide and forms an amine, so we’ll search the template catalog for templates with functional_groups_broken = ["halide"] and functional_groups_formed = ["amine"], limiting the results to a few candidates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
